<details>
The provided script `figlet-gallery` is a simple shell script designed to display a gallery of figlet fonts installed on the system. It lists all `.flf` font files in `/usr/share/figlet/fonts/`, extracts the font name, and uses `figlet` to render a sample text using each font, then pipes the output to `less` for pagination.

The script performs only local file operations and calls `figlet` with predictable arguments derived from the local filesystem. It does not perform any network operations, execute downloaded code, or access sensitive files outside its expected scope. The use of `while read` in a pipeline may cause issues with variable persistence due to subshell isolation, but this is a common shell scripting idiom and does not introduce a security risk here.

All operations are transparent and consistent with the intended purpose of previewing figlet fonts. There is no obfuscation, unexpected system calls, or attempts to exfiltrate data. The script behaves as a benign utility wrapper around `figlet`.
</details>
